4. UNACKNOWLEDGED DATA PROBLEMS: Data shows revenue stored as strings but not used. That's noted in caveats. Any other issues? converted column is int 0/1, fine. No missing data. All rows non-null. So no unacknowledged problems.

5. FALSE PREMISE: No false premise.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, issues empty list.
